# Tabulator 6.6.0

Bundled JavaScript and CSS from the official `tabulator-tables` npm package,
served locally to support offline score entry. See LICENSE for the MIT licence.

Release: https://github.com/tabulator-tables/tabulator/releases/tag/6.6.0
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/tabulator-tables/v/6.6.0

The application's own scoring script validates paste/fill, protects student
details, and adds one undo action per rectangular paste. Native corner-handle
autofill repeats values; it does not create Excel sequences or formulas.
